component.name: MySysPilot
component.summary: System monitor, cleaner, disk utility and data recovery

description.p: MySysPilot is a local dashboard served on 127.0.0.1 only. It combines system monitoring, process, service and startup management, a system cleaner, package uninstaller, a disk utility with backup and restore, data recovery, Docker administration, a duplicate finder and an internet speed test.
Privileged actions are authorized per action through polkit.
